data.title: KNOREX Provides Required Disclosure
data.description: KNOREX Ltd., a prominent provider of AI-driven cross-channel advertising technology solutions, announced that its Annual Report on Form 20F for the year ending December 31, 2025, revealed the inclusion of Financial Statements audited by its Independent Registered Public Accounting Firm. The report emphasized the preparation of Consolidated Financial Statements, with KNOREX being listed on the NYSE American under the ticker symbol KNRX.

data.title: Mesa Royalty Trust Announces There Will Be No Distribution for August 2026
data.description: Houston-based Mesa Royalty Trust (NYSE: MTR) disclosed that no distribution will be made for August 2026. This decision was influenced by the Trust's royalty properties facing higher costs, charges, and expenses compared to the revenue generated from the sale of oil, natural gas, and other hydrocarbons produced from these properties. The Trust, created to possess an overriding royalty interest in the net proceeds from said properties, had to forego distributions due to financial constraints in this specific period.

data.title: Lennar Announces Grand Opening of Prentis Branch in Scenic and Historic Rome, Georgia
data.description: Lennar, a top homebuilder, recently unveiled Prentis Branch, a new community in Rome. The development features five unique home designs, with prices starting in the mid-$200,000 range. The Grand Opening took place on August 21, 2026, showcasing single-family homes in the picturesque and historic Rome area.

data.title: TWO Announces Receipt of Final Regulatory Approval for Merger with CrossCountry Mortgage
data.description: NEW YORK - In a significant development, TWO has officially received the final regulatory approval for its merger with CrossCountry Mortgage. This approval signifies the green light for the consolidation of the two entities. The merger, once completed, will combine the resources and expertise of TWO and CrossCountry Mortgage in a strategic move that is set to reshape the landscape of the mortgage industry. Stay tuned for further updates as this merger progresses towards completion.

data.title: Insteel Industries Announces Closure of Upper Sandusky, Ohio Facility
data.description: Insteel Industries Inc. (NYSE: IIIN) revealed plans to shut down its Upper Sandusky, Ohio facility and transfer manufacturing operations to its other welded wire reinforcement production plants. This decision stems from the surplus capacity available in the company's existing facilities. The move is anticipated to lead to the removal of around 65 positions from the Upper Sandusky location.

data.title: U.S. Marine Corps Awards Accrete Sole-Source Contract for Argus for Cognitive Advantage
data.description: On August 21, 2026, Accrete, a company specializing in cognitive infrastructure and the development of Knowledge Engines for autonomous operations, revealed that they have secured a sole-source contract with the U.S. Marine Corps. The contract is for the delivery of Argus for Cognitive Advantage. This significant agreement underscores the trust placed in Accrete's capabilities by the U.S. Marine Corps and highlights the importance of advanced technologies in modern military operations.

data.title: Evan Sandberg Wins 20th Annual Arizona State Poker Championship
data.description: Yesterday in SALT RIVER PIMA-MARICOPA INDIAN COMMUNITY, Arizona, over 4,000 participants vied for a grand prize worth $4 million at Talking Stick Resort. The event marked the end of two decades of intense rivalry, with Evan Sandberg emerging victorious.

data.title: Toppoint Holdings Announces Postponement of 2026 Annual Meeting of Stockholders to September 8, 2026
data.description: North Wales, Pennsylvania, August 21, 2026 - Toppoint Holdings Inc., a company listed on NYSE American under the ticker symbol TOPP, specializing in truckload services and solutions for the recycling export supply chain, has decided to delay its 2026 Annual Meeting of Stockholders. Originally set for August 24, 2026, at 10:00 a.m. Eastern Time, the meeting will now be conducted virtually through a live webcast on September 8, 2026, at 10:00 a.m. Eastern Time. Shareholders can access the virtual meeting at www.virtualshareholdermeeting.com/TOPP2026.

data.title: Breeze Acquisition Corp. II Announces Receipt of Notice from Nasdaq Regarding Late Filing of Quarterly Reports on Form 10-Q
data.description: On August 20, 2026, Breeze Acquisition Corp. II (NASDAQ: BREZ) based in Irving, Texas, received a notice from Nasdaq stating that they are not in compliance with Nasdaq Listing Rule 5250(c)(1) due to the Company's failure to file its Quarterly Reports on Form 10-Q for the periods ended March 31, 2026 and June 30, 2026. This rule mandates listed companies to promptly submit all necessary periodic financial reports to the Securities and Exchange Commission.

data.title: Bolstered by institutional buying and regulatory optimism, Bitcoin rally gains momentum as billions in short liquidations push price higher.
data.description: Bitcoin's surge is being bolstered by institutional buying, better macro conditions, and a positive regulatory stance. The rally has been fueled further by short liquidations worth billions, pushing the cryptocurrency's value higher.

data.title: Molina Healthcare of Michigan Donates $85,000 to Support Two Organizations Addressing Hunger and Housing in Bay and Saginaw Counties
data.description: Molina Healthcare of Michigan has contributed $85,000 in donations to assist in the efforts of two organizations focused on combating hunger and providing housing support in Bay and Saginaw counties.

data.title: ESS Tech, Inc. Announces Closing of $3.2 Million Registered Direct Offering and Concurrent Private Placement
data.description: Wilsonville, Oregon-based ESS Tech, Inc. has recently finalized a $3.2 million registered direct offering along with a simultaneous private placement. This financial transaction signifies a significant milestone for the company as it aims to further develop its business operations and expansion goals.

data.title: Global Interactive Technologies, Inc. Announces Receipt of a Compliance Delinquency Notice from Nasdaq
data.description: In Seoul, South Korea, on August 21, 2026, Global Interactive Technologies, Inc. (NASDAQ: GITS) revealed that it was issued a compliance delinquency notice on August 20, 2026, by Nasdaq's Listing Qualifications Department. The notice specified that the company had not met the deadline for filing its Quarterly Report on Form 10-Q for the quarter ending June 30, 2026, with the Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC). This non-compliance with Nasdaq's listing regulations under Nasdaq Listing Rule 5250(c)(1), mandating the prompt submission of all necessary periodic reports to the SEC, was highlighted in the notice.

data.title: OBOOK Holdings Inc. (NASDAQ: OWLS) Announces Unaudited First Half 2026 Financial Results as OwlPay Harbor Commercial Scaling Accelerates
data.description: OBOOK Holdings, listed as OWLS on the NASDAQ stock exchange, known as OwlTing, has released its unaudited financial results for the first half of 2026. The company reported a revenue of US$3.87 million during this period. Furthermore, they have highlighted their ongoing efforts to expand their commercial operations through OwlPay Harbor.

data.title: WLTH STOCK NEWS: Robbins LLP Reminds Investors that it is Investigating Potential Securities Claims Involving Wealthfront Corporation
data.description: In San Diego on August 21, 2026, Robbins LLP, a shareholder rights law firm, has initiated an investigation into Wealthfront Corporation (NASDAQ: WLTH). The investigation aims to ascertain if specific officers and directors at Wealthfront may have contravened securities laws and failed in their fiduciary responsibilities towards shareholders. The probe has been launched to delve into potential misconduct and breaches in duties by these individuals.

data.title: Cincinnati Financial Corporation Declares Regular Quarterly Cash Dividend
data.description: On August 21, 2026, Cincinnati Financial Corporation (Nasdaq: CINF) disclosed in a press release that their board of directors approved a regular quarterly cash dividend of 94 cents per share. This dividend will be distributed on October 15, 2026, to shareholders recorded as of a date yet to be specified.
